newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Dec sugar exports ex-key CS ports up on '95.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Dec sugar exports ex-key CS ports up on '95.

text.p: Brazilian sugar shipments from key center-south ports reached 186,578 tonnes in December, against 143,148 tonnes exported in the same month the previous year, individual port authorities said.
Bulk sugar shipments from the terminal operated by the Santos Codesp port authority reached 38,645 tonnes.
There were no shipments of bulk sugar from the CODESP terminal in December 1995.
But bulk sugar shipments from Cargill's private terminal totalled only 591 tonnes, well down from the 14,053 tonnes exported by the terminal in December the previous year.
December bagged sugar shipments were also down at 72,043 tonnes compared with 117,035 tonnes shipped in December 1995.

In Paranagua, bulk sugar shipments were 47,852 tonnes and bagged sugar 8,609 tonnes. Bagged sugar shipments in the same month the previous year were 12,190 tonnes and there were no bulk sugar exports.
In Itajai, bagged sugar shipments in the past month were 19,018 tonnes against 13,332 tonnes in December 1995.
The December figures bring sugar exports from key ports in the center-south region to 3,667,183 tonnes since the harvest began in May against 3,626,395 tonnes in May to December 1995.
-- Caroline Bulloch, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 5074151
